name: Yuri Ivanov
source:
Yuri is a fearless delinquent from Garnaster High, who happens to also be a gang member. He seems to despise students from Valudeto High, and what's more, his mortal enemy, Rico, goes there.

He is currently living with his father, a well-respected surgeon, after his parents divorced, leaving his younger brother, Ignatius, with his mother. It would appear that Yuri's relationship with Ignatius is a bitter one.

Yuri suffers academically as education seems to be of lower priority to him, which gives his younger brother even more reason to loathe him.
